CabanesYourtesPage.title: Cabanes et Yourtes de la Vallée de l'Ance
CabanesYourtesPage.subtitle: Website for unusual accommodations in the heart of nature
CabanesYourtesPage.heroDescription: A showcase website designed to promote eco-friendly accommodations nestled in the Auvergne countryside.
aboutParagraphs: A personal project with professional aims, consisting of designing and developing the showcase website for Cabanes et Yourtes de la Vallée de l'Ance tourist accommodations. The site presents the lodgings, local activities, and availability, highlighting the natural and artisanal identity of the place.

I carry out the entire process: needs analysis, zoning, wireframe, mockup in Figma, front-end integration (HTML, CSS, JavaScript), and deployment. Development is done in continuous interaction with the owners to adjust content and design based on their feedback. The site is fully responsive and relies on a natural palette of green and brown tones. Site images were taken on location with RC Creation.
nrItems: Images optimized in AVIF format to reduce page weight
Subdued color palette limiting energy consumption on OLED screens
Lightweight code without heavy frameworks (HTML, CSS, vanilla JS)
Eco-responsible hosting via Vercel (renewable energy)
No third-party cookies or unnecessary trackers
features: Smooth navigation system
Dynamic data integration for availability
Responsive design adapted to all devices
SEO optimization for organic search
Subtle animations to enhance user experience

IUTDefensePage.title: IUT defense management
IUTDefensePage.subtitle: Web application for managing internship evaluations at the IUT Informatique
IUTDefensePage.heroDescription: A comprehensive web application to centralize the management of internship and apprenticeship defenses.
aboutParagraphs: Team project carried out during the second year of IUT Informatique. The objective was to design a web application centralizing the complete management of internship and apprenticeship defenses: jury assignment, entry and consultation of evaluation grids, grade tracking, account administration (professors, students), automation of certain internal tasks (emails, data uploads) as well as work on data security.

I developed the professor's home page (personalized view of upcoming and past defenses, dynamic sorting) and ensured the complete design integration (global CSS conforming to the IUT's graphic charter).
Collaborative project spanning over a month using agile methodology, with GitHub for version control and VS Code for development.
nrItems: Optimized SQL queries to limit unnecessary database access
No superfluous external JavaScript libraries
Minimalist CSS without heavy CSS frameworks
Access rights management to limit unauthorized requests
features: Dashboard with statistics and indicators
Defense management (rooms, time slots, juries)
Grade submission and validation
CSV export and automatic email sending
Evaluation grid creation and management
User and access rights administration
Personal internship information consultation
Real-time evaluation status tracking

ClimbImprovePage.title: ClimbImprove
ClimbImprovePage.subtitle: Revolutionizing climbing through AI and connected objects
ClimbImprovePage.heroDescription: A conceptual project combining artificial intelligence and connected objects to improve climbing practice.
aboutParagraphs: Completed in pairs as part of an English course during the second year of BUT Informatique. ClimbImprove is a conceptual project aiming to revolutionize climbing through the combination of artificial intelligence and connected objects.

To work within tight deadlines while exploring AI technologies, we used Figma Make to simulate the service architecture. My role was to imagine the overall concept and fully develop the showcase website, the centerpiece of our booth evaluation.

This site details a complete ecosystem: an application capable of biomechanical video analysis ("Movement Analysis") and personalized coaching ("Smart Guidance"), coupled with durable connected holds made of wood and polyester.
nrItems: Lightweight static showcase site without database
Clean design limiting HTTP requests
Use of Figma Make to prototype without developing a server
Connected holds concept using sustainable materials (wood and polyester)
features: Movement Analysis: real-time biomechanical video analysis
Smart Guidance: AI-based personalized coaching
Detailed tracking of climber progression
Pressure sensors integrated into connected holds
Route creation tools for route setters
Load and technique analysis

BandBusinessPage.title: B&Business event landing page
BandBusinessPage.subtitle: Online booking page with payment and back-office, built during my internship at Powehi
BandBusinessPage.heroDescription: An event booking landing page with Stripe payment, a dynamic form and a standalone admin panel.
aboutParagraphs: First mission of my internship at Powehi: design and deploy a booking landing page for a professional event. The business goal was to automate registration and payment notifications, in real time, for both the client and the organizer.

I handled the front-end integration (HTML, CSS, JavaScript), the payment integration through the Stripe API (transactions, webhooks, VAT calculation and promo codes) and the automated sending of transactional emails (invoice and receipt) via PHPMailer over SMTP. The form is adaptive: dynamically adding participants generates new fields through DOM manipulation.

I then built a secure back-office: an admin panel with a WYSIWYG email editor and real-time preview, then a mini-CMS letting the client edit the page's text and images without touching the code. The project was deployed to production through a Git workflow, with a separated front / back architecture for maintainability.
nrItems: Lightweight solution chosen over a heavy CMS (such as WordPress) for performance
Separated front / back architecture for readability and maintainability
Access hardening via .htaccess and environment variables (.env)
Logging system to ensure notifications are received reliably
Secrets kept out of the Git repository (Stripe and SMTP keys)
features: Secure online payment via Stripe (transactions and webhooks)
Automatic VAT calculation and promo code handling
Adaptive form with dynamic participant addition
Automated confirmation emails and invoices (PHPMailer / SMTP)
Back-office with WYSIWYG email editor and real-time preview
Mini-CMS to edit text and images without changing the code
Production deployment via Git (continuous integration)

LeoAgentPage.title: Léo — AI prospecting agent
LeoAgentPage.subtitle: LinkedIn prospecting AI agent (in-house Waalaxy clone), built during my internship at Powehi
LeoAgentPage.heroDescription: An autonomous AI agent automating the agency's LinkedIn prospecting, driven from a web dashboard — built to replace a paid SaaS subscription.
aboutParagraphs: The main project and common thread of my internship at Powehi: build an AI prospecting and community-management agent for LinkedIn, embodied by a virtual persona ("Léo Copain"). The goal was to give the agency an in-house tool able to automate prospecting, freeing it from costly SaaS subscriptions (such as Waalaxy).

The agent (OpenClaw platform) runs on a containerized VPS (Docker) and relies on LLMs (Mistral, then GPT-4.1-mini). I designed a microservices architecture: the AI orchestrates, while a deterministic microservice executes LinkedIn actions through the internal Voyager API (obtained by reverse engineering) and a custom Chrome extension (Manifest V3) that routes requests through the user's residential IP to remain indistinguishable from human behavior.

On the functional side: Wizard-guided campaign creation (to guarantee determinism), prospect scraping, scoring and caching, intent classification of replies (NLP), per-prospect contextual memory, safeguards (GDPR blacklist, human-validated drafts), automated reports (CRON) and multi-channel control (web dashboard, Telegram, Discord). The tool allowed the agency to cancel its Waalaxy subscription.
nrItems: Shared local profile cache to strongly reduce outgoing network requests
Payload optimization: -80% tokens consumed by the LLM
Exploration of local open-source models (independence and frugality)
Data deduplication to avoid redundant processing
Randomized delays and quotas to limit load on third-party platforms
features: Virtual persona "Léo Copain" running prospecting autonomously
Microservices architecture: orchestrating AI + deterministic execution
LinkedIn automation through the internal Voyager API (reverse engineering)
Chrome extension (Manifest V3) for requests indistinguishable from a human
Wizard-guided campaign creation
Prospect scraping, scoring and caching (lead generation)
